QuestInfo.name: Mysterious Strength
QuestInfo.0: There's something about the monsters in the Excavation Site that #p1022006# isn't telling you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022006# wants you to deliver a letter to Dances with Balrog. It contains the results of all the research you helped him with, but it's sealed so you can't read it.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Winston's Letter to Dances with Balrog. What's going on at the Excavation Sites?

0.0: Would you take this letter to Dances with Balrog for me?

yes.0: Cheers! I wish I could tell you what just happened, but it's...you'll see.
Winston sent me a letter? Hm... This can't be right... Thank you. Now, get back to your training.

default.0: Please deliver my letter to Dances with Balrog. We don't have a second to lose.

item.0: If you want to deliver a letter, doesn't it help to actually have the letter? Go back to the person who sent it.

lost.0: You lost my letter? Yes, make an old man write the same note over and over again. Brilliant...
